chansons.style: Contemporary R&B, emotive male vocals, warm vintage keys, gentle strings pad, soulful harmonies, 68 BPM, reflective and wistful
chansons.resume_fr: Une méditation sur le temps qui s'écoule et les instants qu'on ne peut retenir.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
Time keeps slipping through my hands
Oh, where did all the years go

[Verse 1]
I found an old photograph hidden in a drawer
Smiling faces frozen in a moment long before
The children that we were, with dreams we couldn't name
Now we're chasing shadows, and nothing feels the same

[Pre-Chorus]
Every tick of the clock, every breath that I take
Reminds me how the beautiful things always fade

[Chorus]
Hourglass, let me hold this moment a little longer
Hourglass, I'm not ready to let it slip away
Every grain of sand is a memory I'm holding on to
But time won't wait for anyone, no matter what I do

[Verse 2]
My father's voice is softer now, his hair has turned to snow
The stories that he told me are the only things I know
I wish that I had listened more, I wish I'd stayed more near
But the hourglass keeps turning, year after year

[Pre-Chorus]
Every tick of the clock, every breath that I take
Reminds me how the beautiful things always fade

[Chorus]
Hourglass, let me hold this moment a little longer
Hourglass, I'm not ready to let it slip away
Every grain of sand is a memory I'm holding on to
But time won't wait for anyone, no matter what I do

[Bridge]
If I could turn it upside down, would I live it all again
Would I love a little deeper, would I tell my closest friends
Oh, the time we have is borrowed, and the debt is always due

[Chorus]
Hourglass, let me hold this moment a little longer
Hourglass, I'm not ready to let it slip away
Every grain of sand is a memory I'm holding on to
But time won't wait for anyone, no matter what I do

[Outro]
No matter what I do
Time keeps slipping, slipping away
Hourglass, oh hourglass

La dernière valse, avant que tu partes loin
